version_policy: 0.2.0 is only a proposed successor to accepted 0.1.0; no accepted file is rewritten and no runtime decoder exists. Do not claim silent compatibility.

amendments.issue: Accepted phase sorting can run a later producer sequence before an earlier one, conflicting with processing-time high-watermark checks.
amendments.resolution: Validate all sealed-batch identities/sequences against the prior snapshot before phase sorting. Reserve each unique producer sequence once; execute by phase/key; advance the producer watermark to the batch maximum only at completion. Duplicate event IDs need an immutable persisted event ledger.
amendments.contract_change: Add EventLedgerEntry and Snapshot.event_ledger; no processed-phase order is used to reject a previously admitted event in this same batch.

amendments.issue: Accepted REAUTHORIZE fields do not encode the requested [24,80) lease in V07-A-explicit-reauthorization row4.
amendments.resolution: Add requested_permission_interval_ticks=[start,end] to REAUTHORIZE. Require now<=start<end, original requested<=start, latest<end, hold<=end and end<=original packet/evidence expiry. It requests a future logical lease, never an artificial compute/transport delay.
amendments.contract_change: Versioned payload extension. Preserve the original row; the proposed materialization explicitly supplies [24,80].

amendments.issue: RENEWAL_WARNING/T03 clear triggers, warning evidence restoration and reset-to-new-session barriers need exact event/record binding.
amendments.resolution: Add WARNING_CLEAR(evidence_ids,acceptance_id). Treat supplied epoch-install/barrier observations as journaled facts; they grant nothing before exact session/epoch/barrier/context matching and an authorized request. T13 consumes matching new-session evidence; T01 consumes an already prepared/acknowledged session without inventing another epoch.
amendments.contract_change: Add WARNING_CLEAR payload and explicit prepared-barrier references in Configuration/Snapshot context; endpoint observations remain external inputs.

amendments.issue: The accepted compound rows contain batch-level decisions and salient reason lists, whereas exact per-event trace precedence is not fully specified.
amendments.resolution: Emit one Trace per admitted event plus explicit boundary/internal transition traces. Preserve original 69 rows as historical intent; proposed per-event materializations and any changed reason ordering require review. No old row is treated as an executed golden trace.
amendments.contract_change: Add DecisionScope, Denial, TransitionRecord and Reduction. No ambiguous last-event batch decision substitutes for the full ordered trace.

amendments.issue: Snapshot stores only command first_decision_id/high-watermarks, insufficient to distinguish submission, first permission, reauthorization and exact event replay.
amendments.resolution: Persist separate event and operation ledgers. Operation key includes kind plus command_id, and new permission/transition IDs for REAUTHORIZE. Replayed historical acceptance never reactivates a lease.
amendments.contract_change: Add OperationLedgerEntry and Snapshot.operation_ledger; preserve command generation/source identity.

amendments.issue: Core fault closure, phase0 simultaneous causes and restart ordering can otherwise yield arbitrary extra epoch bumps or permissive reset paths.
amendments.resolution: Collect same-tick critical facts before grants. Emergency records T06 where its S0 source is admissible; then T09 if no enabled response. Bump the affected current-session desired epoch at most once per sealed batch; T14 handles lost rest. Restart evidence is checked before any grants; intact snapshots preserve latches/ledgers, missing/corrupt persistence boot-latches T09.
amendments.contract_change: Explicit closure/epoch transaction semantics, not a change to frozen runtime ordering.

amendments.issue: An expiry/freshness threshold crossed between batches and a fresh same-tick observation need a causal interpretation.
amendments.resolution: Visit every crossed boundary. Invalidate the elapsed lease at its exact boundary before later facts. At an inclusive age bound L, the first invalid integer tick is capture_lower+L+1. A fresh observation received at a boundary can support a new grant only after closure rules and cannot restore an expired permission or clear a critical latch.
amendments.contract_change: Timing clarification with conservative bounds; no physical freshness/watchdog value is adopted.

amendments.issue: UNKNOWN/null evidence and opaque operator/producer IDs require typed provenance without implying real authentication or physical validity.
amendments.resolution: Use a configured immutable synthetic authorization registry and explicit assumption/context records. Unknown mappings/evidence deny dependent permission; malformed unauthenticated proposals do not overwrite healthy authoritative state. An authoritative invalid estimate triggers core closure.
amendments.contract_change: Add registry/mapping inputs to the Python configuration. These are fixture role assumptions, not a transport-security implementation.

amendments.issue: Accepted PERMISSION_REQUEST embeds Command but does not say how the literal permission ID p1 is selected; no exact cross-platform identifier policy is specified.
amendments.resolution: Use PermissionRequest(command,permission_id,supersedes_permission_id) in proposed0.2.0. Caller proposes an immutable ID; reducer alone validates and grants. Unknown/reused/conflicting IDs deny permission; supersession needs explicit matching live prior grant and separate fresh validation.
amendments.contract_change: Replace the PERMISSION_REQUEST payload only in proposed0.2.0; original0.1.0 rows remain unchanged.

amendments.issue: A global invalid-batch early return must not suppress a separately valid known critical observation, nor should a malformed unauthenticated proposal alone destroy healthy authority.
amendments.resolution: Decode each input independently. Retain individually validated critical observations. reject_batch is a pure explicit fail-closed reduction entry: isolated malformed proposal denies new work and journals rejection; trusted identity/causal/time integrity failures or known critical events invoke T06/T09 or T14, with no permissions. Never discard already known faults because another input is invalid.
amendments.contract_change: Add reject_batch API and its exact deterministic inputs; review literal mixed-invalid/critical cases before any execution.

time.tick_type: int excluding bool, >=0; SI seconds via exact positive Fraction
time.mappings: Configured ClockMapping is a synthetic assumed affine rational scale/offset with outward integer error bounds. floor(source_tick*scale+offset)-lower_error, ceil(...)+upper_error; reject negative/unknown/reset-unmatched mappings.
time.intervals: [start,end); application upper < end; latest < end; hold_end <= end; packet start=first mapped upper, end=last mapped lower; adjacent timestamp bounds strictly ordered.
time.authority_age: Application/hold upper minus capture lower <= configured age bound. Unknown bound denies nominal authority. Approximately50ms is not an adopted value.

batch_policy.seal: seal_batch validates exact configuration and snapshot fingerprints, common target tick, unique IDs and prior-ledger identity. A trusted event may refer only to an already journaled parent or an earlier topological layer of this sealed batch.
batch_policy.sequence: Sequence admission is a prepass, not a mutation in phase-execution order. For each producer, unique new sequences must exceed prior watermark; gaps are allowed and cannot infer a missing event. Exact known replay is historical only.
batch_policy.same_phase_parent: A same-phase parent must precede child under the declared key; otherwise reject the batch rather than arbitrarily reorder. Cycles and references to future ticks are invalid.
batch_policy.microsteps: External inputs are microstep0. Internal consequences have increasing nonnegative microstep and explicit parent IDs; they are trace/deny/transition records, never new endpoint outcomes. A newly discovered critical fact synchronously updates the deny mask before any remaining permissive action.
batch_policy.closure: Process boundary/critical facts and phases1/2; evaluate admissible continuation before phase4. Critical latch closure cannot be cancelled by a positive same-tick input. No transient STOP_REQUESTED state admits a permission.
batch_policy.invalid_batch: Use individually decoded records; seal failure calls reject_batch with immutable original Snapshot, classified InputErrors and independently validated known critical events. No new grants. Isolated malformed proposal preserves still-admissible authority; critical integrity/fault closure cannot be suppressed.

phases.meaning: Invalidate/revoke/latch first; installation facts alone are not a host barrier acknowledgement.
Consume supplied observations; retain earlier occurrence and present receipt times; unknown/censored means unknown.
Use only received evidence. Acceptance is independent of proposal readiness; fixed deadlines stay explicit.
Guarded logical state/intent decisions; no endpoint acknowledgement generated.
Revalidate current facts; grant only bounded logical permissions.
Unavailable in S1-A. Reject STAGE_NOT_ENABLED before any synthetic endpoint effect.
Unavailable in S1-A; no such output can be generated.

reason_selection: Reject unsupported S1-B input before semantic dispatch. Otherwise select all applicable causes within the first denying category; critical closure may add NO_VALID_POLICY and knowledge annotations. Deduplicate and sort by reason_order. OK is absent when a denial code exists. Per-event Trace separates denial, transition and observation; original compound-row lists remain unchanged pending PC04 materialization review.
fault_latches: Record every simultaneous accepted critical cause in canonical (fault code,event_id) order; one cause cannot erase another. No new grant, warning-clear, reset or healthy sample clears an uncleared critical latch.
restart: Logical persistence only: validate version, configuration binding, canonical digest and required ledger/latch fields. Missing/corrupt evidence creates a disarmed boot snapshot with PERSISTENCE_UNKNOWN then T09, no grants; physical held/application knowledge remains null with reason.
logical_vs_physical: Lease expiry, application permission and cancellation intent never assert a physical input was applied, removed, held safely or stopped.
review_blocker: PC01-PC10 and their literal trace materializations require Engineering/Primary review; no implementation is authorized.
excluded_s1b_policy: Reject before any S1-A effect; the phase gate here does not redefine their accepted future S1-B ordering.
